cells: Entry of the lead table page: answers a browser GET.
Entry (webhook, path demo-table-v2, method GET, webhookId demo-table-v2-wh).
HTTP GET only; no query, no body used (n8n-table-screen-v2/mf-table-screen-v2.json:Receive).
none: no onError, no errorWorkflow in settings (n8n-table-screen-v2/mf-table-screen-v2.json:Receive); if a later node fails the caller gets n8n's own error answer. UNVERIFIED: needs a running n8n.

n8n webhook endpoint with no authentication parameter set (n8n-table-screen-v2/mf-table-screen-v2.json:Receive parameters hold only httpMethod, path, responseMode, options); UNVERIFIED: needs a running n8n for which identity n8n runs as.
n8n execution log; saveDataSuccessExecution and saveDataErrorExecution are none (n8n-table-screen-v2/mf-table-screen-v2.json settings), so no run data kept.
Nothing directly; the browser waits for the reply.
One request, one response; the page itself re-requests every 5 s through a meta refresh tag in the HTML built by BuildHtml.
Reads the newest 50 rows of the lead table: lead_key, state, attempts, mail_sent, alert_sent, updated_at (no name, no e-mail).
SQL text: SELECT lead_key, state, attempts, mail_sent, alert_sent, updated_at FROM mf_leads ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 50; (n8n-table-screen-v2/mf-table-screen-v2.json:ReadLeads).
0 to 50 items, one per row. alwaysOutputData is true in the file (n8n-table-screen-v2/mf-table-screen-v2.json:ReadLeads), so an empty table still passes one empty item on.
none: no onError, no retry. If Postgres is down or the column alert_sent is missing the run errors and no page is sent. UNVERIFIED: needs a running n8n.
READS n8n Postgres table mf_leads (the KEEP-ONE store). The column alert_sent exists only in the v3/v4 table (n8n-flows-v4/mf_leads.sql), NOT in n8n-flows/mf_leads.sql:1-14.
Credential NAME n8n-publish-pg (Postgres), placeholder id PG_CREDENTIAL_ID (n8n-table-screen-v2/mf-table-screen-v2.json:ReadLeads).

The Postgres login saved in n8n credential n8n-publish-pg; rights of that login UNVERIFIED (not in the file; README says only SELECT is run, the login is the same one that the mf flows use for writes, so it is NOT read-only by construction).
One SELECT per page request; LIMIT 50 ends the row count.
Builds the whole HTML page (summary strip, table, light and dark colours, state badges, 5 s refresh) in one expression.
The rows from ReadLeads (items without lead_key are dropped by .filter(j => j.lead_key), which is how an empty table gives 'No leads yet').
One field named html (a string) on one item; executeOnce is true (n8n-table-screen-v2/mf-table-screen-v2.json:BuildHtml).
none: a pure expression; a JavaScript error in it stops the run, no page. Not run in n8n (README 'Unverified' section). UNVERIFIED: needs a running n8n.
none; same input gives same page.
n8n expression runtime (inside n8n; no separate identity).

The page text: title Lead table, counts per state, one row per lead (lead_key shown, escaped by esc() for & < > quote), mail and alert words, tries, time HH:MM:SS UTC, footer 'refreshes every 5 s; made-up data'.
Sends the page back to the browser with Content-Type text/html.
none: no error branch. UNVERIFIED: needs a running n8n.

The Lead table page in a browser; the lead_key text is chosen by whoever sent the lead (mf-form takes lead_key from body.submission_id: n8n-flows-real-v5/mf-form.json:Item) and is shown on this unauthenticated page (escaped).
End of the request. A page opened in a browser re-requests itself every 5 s, with no stop condition.
Entry of the desk-door error workflow: starts when a door workflow that names this workflow as its error workflow fails.

Entry (errorTrigger). No file in n8n-flows names it: all 7 flow files have 0 errorWorkflow keys (grep count); the link is set at deploy time by n8n-tests/dn1_common.py:103 (build_flows.py:44 adds settings.errorWorkflow only when an id is passed).
none inside this flow; no errorWorkflow in its own settings, so a failure of this workflow is not reported anywhere.
none (a repeated alert is possible: each failed door run starts one run of this flow).
n8n. It must be ACTIVE or n8n logs 'is not active and cannot be executed' (comment at n8n-tests/dn1_common.py:100).
One run per failed door run.
Sends one plain-text alert e-mail: 'The desk did not answer after retries', the error message and the execution id.
From address desk-door@example.test (constant), to address from environment name DESK_ALERT_TO, text built from $json.execution.error.message and $json.execution.id.
One e-mail through the SMTP server of credential desk-alert-smtp.

Retry on fail true, 3 tries, 1000 ms between (n8n-flows/desk-error-notifier.json:Notify). After the 3 tries nothing else happens: no second channel, no table row, no log outside n8n. Same limit as in N8N-START.md 'Honest limit' for the mf alerts. UNVERIFIED: needs a running n8n.
none (not keyed; if the door fails twice there are two mails; if a try times out after delivery the mail can be doubled).

Environment name DESK_ALERT_TO (read through $env; needs N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false); credential NAME desk-alert-smtp, placeholder id CREDENTIAL_ID_PLACEHOLDER (n8n-flows/desk-error-notifier.json:Notify). The mf flows use a different SMTP credential name, mf-mail-smtp.
SMTP login saved in n8n credential desk-alert-smtp; rights UNVERIFIED.
The alert mail: subject 'Lead desk door: the desk did not answer', body holds the message 'desk_unreachable lead_id=<source_ref>' and the execution id.
Entry of the web form door: receives a lead as an HTTP POST.
Entry (webhook, POST, path desk-form, webhookId door-form-wh).
JSON body of the caller; the path name is desk-form.
One item to 'Map to the desk format'.
none: no onError, no errorWorkflow in the file (n8n-flows/desk-form-door.json:Receive the submission). UNVERIFIED: needs a running n8n.
none here; the key is made in the next node.
none; the webhook has no authentication parameter (n8n-flows/desk-form-door.json:Receive the submission parameters hold only httpMethod, path, responseMode, options).
n8n webhook; UNVERIFIED: needs a running n8n for the identity.
Nothing directly; the caller waits for the reply of Reply 2xx or Reply error.
Maps the caller's fields to the desk format: source, source_ref and a payload object.
Body fields: name, email, phone, company, message.
Fields source='form', source_ref = body.submission_id, payload object (personal data: name, e-mail, phone, company, message).
none: a missing field becomes undefined in the expression; no validation node. UNVERIFIED: needs a running n8n.

source_ref = body.submission_id (caller chosen; the desk keeps a receipt per source_ref: n8n-tests/dn1_common.py:145 counts receipts by source_ref). A missing submission_id gives an empty key: UNVERIFIED how the desk reacts.
Posts the lead to the desk over HTTP: POST $env.DESK_URL/leads with source, source_ref, payload.
Environment names DESK_URL and DESK_TIMEOUT_MS; JSON body from the previous node.
Output 0 (success, full response incl. status and body) to 'Shape the reply'; output 1 (error output) to 'Shape the error reply'.

Retry on fail true, 3 tries, 1000 ms; onError continueErrorOutput; neverError false, so any non-2xx answer also counts as an error and is retried 3 times, including a 4xx that retrying cannot fix (n8n-flows/desk-form-door.json:Send to the desk). After the 3 tries the error output carries on to Reply error then Fail the run. UNVERIFIED: needs a running n8n.

source_ref (sent on every one of the 3 tries); safe only if the desk dedupes on source_ref: UNVERIFIED (desk code is not in this repository; evidence of a receipt table only at n8n-tests/dn1_common.py:145).

The desk's own store: SQLite file(s) under the desk checkout data/ folder with tables leads, followups, receipts (n8n-tests/dn1_common.py:137-145). NOT n8n Postgres mf_leads. Classification RETIRED per the order text; the desk code is outside this repository.
Environment names DESK_URL, DESK_TIMEOUT_MS. No credential: the call to the desk has no authentication (n8n-flows/desk-form-door.json:Send to the desk has no credentials key).
none: calls the desk with no identity; UNVERIFIED: needs a running n8n.
n8n execution log (off); the desk logs on its side: UNVERIFIED.
3 tries, then the error output. Timeout from DESK_TIMEOUT_MS per try.
Reads the desk's answer and decides: has a verdict or not.
The full HTTP response ($input.first().json: statusCode, body).
If body.verdict exists: n8n_error false, desk_status, verdict, the whole desk body, lead_ref. Else n8n_error true with 'desk answer had no verdict'.

In-code: a body that is not JSON or has no verdict becomes n8n_error true; it then goes to Reply 2xx, which answers 502, but it never reaches Fail the run, so the error workflow is NOT started and no alert mail is sent for this case (n8n-flows/desk-form-door.json:Shape the reply and :Reply 2xx).
Nothing directly; the whole desk body (desk) is returned to the webhook caller: UNVERIFIED what it contains (could echo the payload's personal data).
Makes the error answer after the 3 failed tries to the desk.
Send to the desk (output 1, error output).
Nothing from the response; reads source_ref from node 'Map to the desk format'.
Item with n8n_error true, error 'desk call failed after retries', lead_ref.
Sends the success answer to the caller; status 502 if n8n_error is true, else 200.
none. The name 'Reply 2xx' is misleading: it also sends 502.
The caller sees the verdict and desk body (200) or the 'no verdict' error (502).
Sends the 502 reply to the caller after the desk failed.
none: if sending fails nothing else happens. UNVERIFIED: needs a running n8n.
The caller sees a 502 with 'desk call failed after retries' and its lead_ref, so the caller can retry with the same ref.
Reply sent, then Fail the run starts.
Ends the run in an error state so n8n starts the error workflow (the notifier), with the text desk_unreachable lead_id=<ref>.
No data: run ends as failed.

This node IS the error path. It fires the error workflow only if settings.errorWorkflow was set at deploy time; the saved file has none (n8n-flows/desk-form-door.json settings: executionOrder, saveDataSuccessExecution, saveDataErrorExecution, saveManualExecutions), so after a plain import no alert goes out. UNVERIFIED: needs a running n8n.
n8n execution log (saving off, so the failed run's data is not kept: only the error message reaches the notifier).
Only the alert mail from desk-error-notifier.json:Notify, if wired.
